text: 中国8月新增社融1.66万亿元，人民币贷款增加600亿元，前8月股债融资占比首次超过贷款。 中国金融时报：贷款规模提质降速成为新常态。 欧洲央行管委Kazimir：如有必要将毫不犹豫地进一步加息。 欧洲央行管委Simkus：任何一次政策会议都有可能采取利率行动。 高盛大幅上修27/28年光模块需求，称供应链紧张将是明年最大出货瓶颈。 报道：铠侠考虑赴美发行ADR募资至少100亿美元，或于明年上市。 三星、SK海力士拒绝向韩国电力预付190亿美元电费。 OpenAI总裁称为AI开发减速应主要针对前沿模型。 比亚迪高管：随着闪充技术的普及，燃油车已没有未来。
text_en: China's August new social financing was 1.66 trillion yuan, with RMB loans increasing by 60 billion yuan. For the first eight months, the share of equity and bond financing exceeded loans for the first time. China Financial Times: Improving the quality of loan scale and slowing its growth has become the new normal. ECB Governing Council member Kazimir: We will not hesitate to raise rates further if necessary. ECB Governing Council member Simkus: Any policy meeting could see interest rate action. Goldman Sachs sharply raised its 2027/2028 optical module demand forecast, saying supply chain tightness will be the biggest shipment bottleneck next year. Report: Kioxia is considering issuing ADRs in the US to raise at least $10 billion and may list next year. Samsung and SK Hynix refuse to prepay $19 billion in electricity fees to Korea Electric Power. OpenAI president says slowing AI development should mainly target frontier models. BYD executive: With the spread of fast-charging technology, fuel vehicles have no future.
